Name: esm2_vs_evo2_comparison
Title: Protein vs DNA Embeddings for Functional Classification: ESM-2 vs Evo2 on DNA Repair vs Tumor Suppressor Genes
Experiment: Using cached ESM-2 embeddings from run_0/data/, train the same MLP classifier (256->128->1) used in the Evo2 experiment and report AUROC, accuracy, F1. Compare directly to the Evo2 result (0.78 AUROC). Additionally run the same unsupervised geometry analysis: k-means ARI, within/between class cosine distance ratio, silhouette score. The key comparison table should show: ESM-2 supervised AUROC vs Evo2 (0.78), ESM-2 silhouette vs Evo2 (0.044), ESM-2 distance ratio vs Evo2 (0.963). If ESM-2 shows both higher AUROC AND better unsupervised clustering, it suggests protein sequence space is more functionally organised than DNA sequence space for these gene classes.
